scope: Substantive refresh of an existing post at its URL, adding sources

observations.summary: Most tap water scald injuries and deaths are to the elderly and children under five; 140 degree water can cause third degree burns in six seconds; CPSC urges lowering water heaters to 120 degrees Fahrenheit.
observations.inference_limit: National consumer safety guidance; does not address shower valves.

observations.summary: Town of Truckee building handout 'Water Temperature Limiting Devices': the code requires an ASSE 1016 valve for showers and tub shower combinations, described as pressure balancing, thermostatic mixing and temperature limiting, with a maximum delivered water temperature of 120F; the water heater thermostat cannot serve this function.
observations.inference_limit: A California jurisdiction's summary of the California Plumbing Code, not the code text; Santa Cruz County inspectors were not consulted.

observations.summary: Retitled from 'Boost Shower Pressure' (the post is about valves) to a descriptive title and corrected hero alt text to the valve diagram. Kept a shortened version of the company's own job story. Added repair versus replace, valve types, code note, scald safety, FAQ and sources. Original date kept, updated set to 2026-10-26.
